qos.name: QoS Level
qos.description: MQTT QoS level of data messages, write requests and write responses. State messages always use QoS 1.
qos.description_zh: 数据消息、控制请求与控制响应使用的 MQTT 服务质量等级。状态消息固定使用 QoS 1。

topic-prefix.name: Topic Prefix
topic-prefix.description: Prefix of all topics, `${app}` is replaced by the app name. The app online state is published to `{prefix}/state`. Each subscribed device uses `{prefix}/{device}/state`, `{prefix}/{device}/data`, `{prefix}/{device}/write/request` and `{prefix}/{device}/write/response`. A subscription can set its own data topic with the `topic` parameter, using `${prefix}`, `${app}`, `${device}` and `${group}`, `${prefix}/${device}/data` being the default.
topic-prefix.description_zh: 所有 topic 的前缀，`${app}` 会替换为北向应用名称。北向在线状态发布到 `{前缀}/state`。每个订阅的设备使用 `{前缀}/{设备}/state`、`{前缀}/{设备}/data`、`{前缀}/{设备}/write/request` 和 `{前缀}/{设备}/write/response`。订阅时可通过 `topic` 参数单独指定该组的数据 topic，可用 `${prefix}`、`${app}`、`${device}`、`${group}`，默认值即 `${prefix}/${device}/data`。

data-template.name: Data Template
data-template.description: JSON template of data messages, rendered for every report of a subscribed group. Variables: ${app}, ${device}, ${group}, ${timestamp}, ${TIME_RFC3339}, ${TIME_UTC}, ${TIME_LOCAL}, ${TIME_UNIX}, ${TIME:<strftime format>}, ${sub_topic}, ${tags} (array), ${tags_kv} (object keyed by tag name), ${tags[name]}, ${tags[name].value} (any tag attribute), ${properties} (object of the device properties), ${properties[key]}. A field whose variable has no value is left out.
data-template.description_zh: 数据消息的 JSON 模板，订阅组每次上报渲染一次。变量：${app}、${device}、${group}、${timestamp}、${TIME_RFC3339}、${TIME_UTC}、${TIME_LOCAL}、${TIME_UNIX}、${TIME:<strftime 格式>}、${sub_topic}、${tags}（数组）、${tags_kv}（以点位名为 key 的对象）、${tags[名称]}、${tags[名称].value}（任意点位属性）、${properties}（设备属性组成的对象）、${properties[key]}。变量取不到值时，该字段不输出。

tag-template.name: Tag Template
tag-template.description: JSON template of every tag expanded by ${tags}, ${tags_kv} and ${tags[name]}. Variables: ${tag.name}, ${tag.value}, ${tag.timestamp}, ${tag.sourceTimestamp}, ${tag.serverTimestamp}, ${tag.quality}, ${tag.description}, ${tag.unit}, ${tag.error}, ${tag.type}, and the non tag variables of the data template. A field whose variable has no value is left out. Tags that fail to be read are reported only when this template uses ${tag.error}.
tag-template.description_zh: ${tags}、${tags_kv}、${tags[名称]} 展开每个点位时使用的 JSON 模板。变量：${tag.name}、${tag.value}、${tag.timestamp}、${tag.sourceTimestamp}、${tag.serverTimestamp}、${tag.quality}、${tag.description}、${tag.unit}、${tag.error}、${tag.type}，以及数据模板中与点位无关的变量。变量取不到值时，该字段不输出。只有模板里使用了 ${tag.error}，才会上报读取失败的点位。

ssl.name: SSL
ssl.description_zh: 是否启用 SSL 连接

ca.name: CA
ca.description: CA certificate which signs the server certificate
ca.description_zh: 签发服务器证书的 CA 证书

cert.name: Client Cert
cert.description: Client x509 certificate when using two way authentication
cert.description_zh: 使用双向认证时，客户端的 x509 证书

key.name: Client Private Key
key.description: Client private key when using two way authentication
key.description_zh: 使用双向认证时，客户端的私钥

offline-cache.name: Offline Data Caching
offline-cache.description: Offline caching switch. Cache data messages when offline, and sync cached messages when back online. State messages are not cached, they are published again once connected.
offline-cache.description_zh: 离线缓存开关。连接断开时缓存数据消息，连接重建时同步缓存的消息到服务器。状态消息不缓存，重新连接后会重新发布。

cache-mem-size.name: Cache Memory Size (MB)
cache-mem-size.description: Max in-memory cache size in megabytes when MQTT connection exception occurs. Should be smaller than cache disk size.
cache-mem-size.description_zh: 当 MQTT 连接异常时，最大的内存缓存大小（单位：MB）。应该小于缓存磁盘大小。

cache-disk-size.name: Cache Disk Size (MB)
cache-disk-size.description: Max in-disk cache size in megabytes when MQTT connection exception occurs. Should be larger than cache memory size.
cache-disk-size.description_zh: 当 MQTT 连接异常时，最大的磁盘缓存大小（单位：MB）。应该大于缓存内存大小。
